controls.legacy_section: NUMBER OF WEEKS SINCE LAST VISIT
controls.notes: Threshold in whole weeks, validation min 0, max 520. Inferred semantics (not documented): a row qualifies when the contract is not soft-deleted (ortho_plans.is_active = true, applied on every grain) and is in treatment (contract_status = 'active', NEW column from DATA-42; until then approximated as coalesce(debond_date, treat_end_date) IS NULL OR >= the office's local today, with warning ortho_contract_status_unavailable), the patient has no live appointment on or after the office's today (rpt_patient_activity.next_appointment_date IS NULL; cancelled / no-show excluded), and weeks_since_last_visit >= threshold, where last visit = rpt_ortho_contracts.last_visit_date (last ortho_visits row of the contract after DATA-42; before: last charge with is_ortho_code AND NOT is_contract_billing, change requested in RPT-ORTHO-02). A contract with no visit at all is listed (weeks shown blank, flagged 'no visit'). Confirm on the live tool: which last visit, >= or >, whether a same-day appointment counts as future, and whether patients with a future appointment are excluded regardless of weeks.

legacy_corrections.text: Hidden population rule with no criteria control: the report identifies patients overdue for a visit - patients with an active ortho contract and no future appointment. How the NUMBER OF WEEKS SINCE LAST VISIT threshold combines with that rule is not documented.

Optional attribute range ortho_start_date, blank = no restriction (captured blank: the screenshot cannot prove whether blank is the default or the criteria had been cleared - confirm on the live tool). Binds to rpt_ortho_contracts ortho start = coalesce(banding_date, treat_start_date) as 03 section 2.25 defines it; 04 section 3 names treat_start_date alone - 03 owns the column (open question). Contracts without any start date are dropped whenever a bound is set.
End of the ortho_start_date attribute range, inclusive; blank = open end. Same binding and caveat as the Start Date box.

Optional attribute range ortho_last_visit_date, blank = no restriction. Vendor: Last Visit on this report = date of service of the last Ortho Treatment Card entry (rpt_ortho_contracts.last_visit_date, last ortho_visits row after DATA-42), not the general last visit (rpt_patient_activity.last_visit_date). A patient without an ortho visit is dropped whenever a bound is set.
End of the ortho_last_visit_date attribute range, inclusive; blank = open end.

Status = the status of the newest ortho treatment plan in the legacy tool; here rpt_ortho_contracts.ortho_status_code.

Attribute range ortho_start_date, legacy default today (date token today in the office time zone). Binds to coalesce(banding_date, treat_start_date) of rpt_ortho_contracts (03 section 2.25; NEW computed column ortho_start_date via RPT-ORTHO-02). Combined with PATIENT FIRST VISIT by AND [I] (04 section 11 open item 'Two ortho ranges'). Every ortho visit belongs to a contract (DATA-42 ortho_visits.ortho_plan_id NOT NULL), so the vendor's second use 'visit but not started' = a contract with first_ortho_visit_date set and ortho_start_date IS NULL, reached with this range blank; confirm the legacy meaning on the live tool.
End of the ortho_start_date attribute range, inclusive; default today.

Attribute range ortho_first_visit_date, legacy default today. Vendor: First Visit = first Ortho Treatment Card entry (min ortho_visits.visit_date of the patient, NEW column first_ortho_visit_date for rpt_ortho_contracts, owner 03), not the first visit to the practice (rpt_patient_activity.first_visit_date). Combined with ORTHO START DATE by AND [I].
End of the ortho_first_visit_date attribute range, inclusive; default today.

controls.notes: Member ledger_transaction of missing_items (enum_multi, options on this report: ledger_transaction, ortho_visit; min_items 1; semantics.full_selection = predicate). Ticked: an appointment qualifies when no live charge exists for the patient in the appointment's office on the appointment date (any is_ledger_code charge; rpt_charges). Inferred rule (supplement, unresolved): a row is listed when at least one ticked item is missing (OR across ticked items).

Member ortho_visit of missing_items. Ticked: an appointment qualifies when no ortho_visits row (DATA-42) exists for the patient on the appointment date in the appointment's office. Inferred rule: OR across ticked items; both ticked (default) = appointments missing a ledger transaction, an ortho visit, or both.

legacy_corrections.text: Audit rule behind the report, with no criteria control for the population: every ortho patient with an appointment should have an Ortho Visit on the Ortho Treatment Card and a ledger entry. The two MISSING ticks carry the names of these two items; how the ticks select rows is inferred only.
